description: A manual bKash/Nagad payment submission from a user, reviewed by the admin in the Payments tab.

fields.name: UserId
fields.description: IAM record id (iam.me().data.itemId) of the submitting user

fields.name: UserEmail
fields.description: Submitter email, shown in the admin review queue

fields.name: Method
fields.description: Which channel the money was sent over: bkash | nagad

fields.name: TxnId
fields.description: Transaction ID from the bKash/Nagad confirmation; unique across all submissions

fields.name: Amount
fields.description: Amount the user says they sent, as a display string taken from the settings price

fields.name: ApprovedUntil
fields.description: ISO date until which this approval grants Pro; empty until approved

fields.name: ReviewNote
fields.description: Optional admin note recorded on approve/reject
